about: Revelstoke is a city in British Columbia’s Columbia Mountains, on the Columbia River and the Trans-Canada Highway between the Rogers Pass and the Interior. Railway heritage, Revelstoke Mountain Resort, and Mount Revelstoke National Park on the town’s doorstep define this mountain city. About 8,000 people live in Revelstoke.
